description: Begin a chunked upload for an image YOU generated in this conversation whose base64 is too large to send inline (a chart, quote card, or edited image). Returns an uploadId; then stream the base64 in small chunks via append_generated_media_chunk and finish with finish_generated_media_upload. Images only, 3MB decoded max. Intended for files generated in this conversation (charts, cards, edited images); user-attached files and files on the user's device are handled by attach_media (the in-chat upload widget, full quality). Chunks are limited to 8000 base64 characters because larger payloads are silently truncated by the chat channel.

altText.description: Alt text stored with the image (recommended). A post that uses this image's url gets it as alt text unless the post sets its own altText.

fileName.description: File name to store under (e.g. chart.png).

mimeType.description: Image MIME type of the file you generated (e.g. image/png). Images only.

name: begin_generated_media_upload
title: Begin Generated Media Upload
